text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone~! It's the local idol
straight from Tomakomai, Hokko Tarumae, be~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was taking a stroll in a quiet spot to clear my head.
Hearing a young girl's voice, I turned to look……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to tell everyone!
Actually, I――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm the princess of the Tartar Kingdom
underneath Mt. Tarumae, taru☆
Pleased to meetcha, taru~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, maybe that's a bit too far-fetched after all.
A setting without realism isn't for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to avoid getting overshadowed
in the upcoming joint live...!
Focusing on impact isn't the wrong call, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A premise that attracts tons of people and stands out the most... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Maybe a swan mascot costume would work!
If we go for a cute and squishy mascot route...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
My name is Hakuccho!
After soaring through the vast skies,
I love resting my wings at Lake Utonai~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that might work! Wearing a mascot costume
would make it look realistic... and... wait—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!!? U-Um!
This is, well...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Could you please keep what you just saw a secret!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's essential for a local idol, but calculating my whole persona is top secret, okay...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I recall, 'locodols' are local idols who promote their hometowns. It seems she was brainstorming ways to make her appeal.
choice_data_list: You're quite dedicated to your studies.
You're quite dedicated to your studies.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No, this is only natural.
It's all to help everyone learn about Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: To make a memorable impression, I tried exploring various personas, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Um... You were watching earlier, weren't you?
What did you think... of the swan costume idea?
choice_data_list: Maybe it's ahead of its time.
If we patiently flesh out the setting, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Urk...! So what you're saying is,
it lacks mass appeal...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There have been plenty of celebrities spoken of that way in the past. If so, by compiling trends and analyzing them, we might be able to derive a countermeasure—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll go look up footage and articles about people who were ahead of their time!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
In that case, I'll start brainstorming
a character gimmick for 'Hakucho'!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should make it look more like a real swan.
I'm gonna look into Tomakomai's swans in detail!
